11:  * hand written guard that returns null on any shape violation, so a
12:  * damaged file drops out of the registry and the badge falls back to
13:  * its placeholder instead of rendering a claim it cannot back up.
14:  */

16: /** One of the three approved receipts (docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md). */
17: export type ReceiptRole = 'root' | 'modelcard' | 'fingerprint'
18: 
19: export interface ChainReceipt {
20:   role: ReceiptRole
21:   /** File whose bytes the on chain memo digest was computed over. */
22:   sourceFile: string
23:   signature: string
24:   payloadSha256: string
25:   cluster: string
26:   confirmedAt: string
27:   explorerUrl: string
28:   evidenceHref: string
29:   label: string
30:   matchesLocal: boolean
31: }

33: /** The evidence filename each receipt role ships under, root first. */
34: const ROLE_BY_FILENAME: Readonly<Record<string, ReceiptRole>> = {
35:   'memo-devnet.json': 'root',
36:   'memo-devnet-modelcard.json': 'modelcard',
37:   'memo-devnet-fingerprint.json': 'fingerprint',
38: }
39: 
40: /** The approved labels, one per receipt (docs/ideas-tangerine-solana.md). */
41: const LABEL_BY_ROLE: Record<ReceiptRole, string> = {
42:   root: 'findings.json root memo, devnet',
43:   modelcard: 'model_card.json hash, devnet',
44:   fingerprint: 'F1 aggregate fingerprint, aggregates only, no raw rows',
45: }
46: 
47: /** Registry order: root first, then the model card, then the fingerprint. */
48: const ROLE_ORDER: Record<ReceiptRole, number> = { root: 0, modelcard: 1, fingerprint: 2 }
49: 
50: /** Bundled evidence link for one filename, base path aware. */
51: export function evidenceHref(filename: string): string {
52:   return `${dataBase()}data/${filename}`
53: }
54: 
55: /**
56:  * Parse one raw evidence object under a known filename. Returns null
57:  * when the filename is not a receipt, when the object is not an
58:  * object, or when any required field is missing or the wrong type:
59:  * a non empty signature, a 64 character lowercase hex digest, the
60:  * devnet cluster the labels promise, a non empty confirmation time,
61:  * an explorer link on the Solana explorer, a boolean matches_local,
62:  * and a payload source of the form file:<path>.
63:  */
64: export function parseChainReceipt(raw: unknown, filename: string): ChainReceipt | null {
65:   const role = ROLE_BY_FILENAME[filename]
66:   if (role === undefined) return null
67:   if (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object') return null
68:   const record = raw as Record<string, unknown>
69: 
70:   const signature = record.signature
71:   if (typeof signature !== 'string' || signature.length === 0) return null
72: 
73:   const payloadSha256 = record.payload_sha256
74:   if (typeof payloadSha256 !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(payloadSha256)) return null
75: 
76:   if (record.cluster !== 'devnet') return null
77: 
78:   const confirmedAt = record.confirmed_at
79:   if (typeof confirmedAt !== 'string' || confirmedAt.length === 0) return null
80: 
81:   const explorerUrl = record.explorer_url
82:   if (typeof explorerUrl !== 'string') return null
83:   if (!explorerUrl.startsWith('https://explorer.solana.com/tx/')) return null
84: 
85:   const matchesLocal = record.matches_local
86:   if (typeof matchesLocal !== 'boolean') return null
87: 
88:   const payload = record.payload
89:   if (payload === null || typeof payload !== 'object') return null
90:   const source = (payload as Record<string, unknown>).source
91:   if (typeof source !== 'string' || !source.startsWith('file:')) return null
92:   const sourceFile = source.slice('file:'.length)
93:   if (sourceFile.length === 0) return null
94: 
95:   return {
96:     role,
97:     sourceFile,
98:     signature,
99:     payloadSha256,
100:     cluster: 'devnet',
101:     confirmedAt,
102:     explorerUrl,
103:     evidenceHref: evidenceHref(filename),
104:     label: LABEL_BY_ROLE[role],
105:     matchesLocal,
106:   }
107: }
108: 
109: /** The bundled evidence modules Vite inlines at build time. */
110: const BUNDLED_EVIDENCE = import.meta.glob<{ default: unknown }>(
111:   '../../public/data/memo-devnet*.json',
112:   { eager: true },
113: )
114: 
115: /**
116:  * Every bundled receipt that parses, root first. A file missing from
117:  * public/data is simply absent from the glob, and a file that fails
118:  * the guard drops out, so a gate failure ships the honest placeholder
119:  * rather than a broken build.
120:  */
121: export function loadBundledReceipts(): ChainReceipt[] {
122:   const receipts: ChainReceipt[] = []
123:   for (const [path, module] of Object.entries(BUNDLED_EVIDENCE)) {
124:     const filename = path.split('/').pop() ?? ''
125:     const receipt = parseChainReceipt(module.default, filename)
126:     if (receipt !== null) receipts.push(receipt)
127:   }
128:   receipts.sort((left, right) => ROLE_ORDER[left.role] - ROLE_ORDER[right.role])
129:   return receipts
130: }
131: 
132: /**
133:  * Map one receipt onto the badge evidence props: verified comes from
134:  * the build time read back recorded in matches_local, plus the
135:  * signature and the approved label. Null in, null out, so an absent
136:  * receipt renders the pinned placeholder.
137:  */
138: export function toMemoEvidence(receipt: ChainReceipt | null | undefined): MemoEvidence | null {
139:   if (!receipt) return null
140:   return {
141:     signature: receipt.signature,
142:     verified: receipt.matchesLocal,
143:     label: receipt.label,
144:   }
145: }
